# proxmox_role (Data Source)

Fetches details of a single Proxmox VE access role from `/access/roles/{roleid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_role" "admin" {
  role_id = "Administrator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Proxmox role identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role identifier.
- `privs` (String) Comma-separated list of privileges.
